How It Works

What You Get

2D & 3D Art

UI Systems

Input Handling

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does generation take?

Most games are ready in 15-30 minutes, depending on complexity.

What engine is used?

Godot 4 — open source, no license fees. You get the full source project.

Can I edit the game after?

Yes! You receive the complete Godot project. Open it in Godot and modify anything.

What platforms can the game run on?

We currently export Windows executables. Mac and Linux exports are coming soon.

What if generation fails?

If we can't produce a working game, you'll receive a full refund.
